children: The Estate of Alvin Libin and affiliates reported a stake in Riley Exploration Permian Inc. (REPX) in a Schedule 13D filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission with a November 12, 2026 event date.

Beneficial Ownership Reported: 
 
- The Estate of Alvin Libin: 2236921.00, 10.11% 
- Balmon Investments Inc.: 2236921.00, 10.11%
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1001614/000121390026122366/xslSCHEDULE_13D_X01/primary_doc.xml
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1001614/000121390026122366/0001213900-26-122366-index.htm

A Schedule 13D is filed with the SEC within 10 days of an entity's attaining 5% or greater position in any class of a company's securities. Subsequent changes in holdings or intentions must be reported in amended filings.
